unit: montage editor (repair 2: regenerated from the render)
about: Dual-column score: picture | commentary | sound, regenerated by score_from_render.py from exposure.json (rendered-frame events), assembly-cues.json (caption onsets and every sound the film places) and mechanism.json. Supersedes the commentary-sound unit's sim-based score.

shots.picture: The toned wall fades up; the title is scratched in white (0.85-2.05 s); the pusher walks in; the carrier stands at the rope.
shots.commentary: 1.6-3.9 s lineage line: after Jean Jabely's Teuf-Teuf (1956), original captions
sound: 0.00 room bed (foraged, PDSounds church walking, low-passed)

shots.picture: DRAG. 9 stick-slip lurches (first slip 5.01 s); the 4th stick begins 6.51 s; push ends 11.5 s at 1.20 m; 1.2 m ghost scratched in at 11.7 s. Reset cut at 13.0 s (held black, scratch wipe).
SUBSTITUTE I. Stone levered up in 3 frames (lift 13.28 s); three bark logs rolled in (13.55, 13.55, 13.55 s); settles 13.62 s.
ROLLERS, wide; the camera pushes in to x1.28 over 14.0-14.5 s so the logs read as logs; logs turn at v/2 and drift back; the carrier walks to log D and picks it up.
TEST SHOT, close-up x2.2 at the same tau. Log A squeezed out behind (16.93 s) and stops (17.44 s, tok); the stone waits from 17.6 s.
shots.commentary: caption 2 at 17.778 s (the only nonhuman line)

shots.picture: Wide (push-in framing). The carrier sets log D down in front (19.3 s); push resumes 19.6 s; the stone rides onto D (20.5 s).
sound: 19.30 log D set down in front

shots.picture: Rolls on; log B also left behind (21.68 s); stops at 3.00 m (23.0 s); the camera pulls back to the full wall 23.0-23.6 s; 3 m ghost at 23.15 s. Reset cut 25.0 s.
WHEEL AND AXLE. Plank cart on two Ljubljana-wheel cutouts; the carrier walks ahead of the load, clear of it; passes 3 m at 28.61 s; 8.00 m at 33.0 s; 8 m ghost at 33.35 s. Reset cut 34.0 s.

COUNTER-CHECK. Pins pulled 34.7 s; same push from 35.0 s; the loose wheels drift back under the platform; the rear wheel rolls out at 35.88 s, kicked out behind the pusher in front of his legs, and settles behind him (36.88 s, tok); the platform's rear falls for 0.30 s and lands 36.17 s; grinds to a stop at 36.23 s, 0.88 m.
sound: 36.17 platform's rear lands on the ground (after a 0.30 s fall)
36.88 tok: the loose wheel settles behind the pusher

shots.picture: COMPARISON HELD. Three ghosts (1.2 / 3.0 / 8.0 m); the figures sit; the loose wheel lying behind rocks once (41.0 s, tok).
shots.commentary: 39.8-44.0 s end line written on, staged-sequence label first, then sources

captions.cause: the 4th stick begins: the stone holds after its 3rd lurch
captions.fr: « La pierre avance d'un pas, puis elle réfléchit. »
captions.en: The stone takes a step, then thinks it over.

captions.cause: log A stops behind the stone (tok)
captions.fr: « Et moi ? » dit le rouleau qu'on laisse derrière.
captions.en: "And me?" says the roller left behind.
captions.voice: the log (the film's only nonhuman line)

captions.cause: the cart passes the 3 m roller ghost
captions.fr: « La roue tourne sur place ; c'est tout le reste qui voyage. »
captions.en: The wheel turns on the spot; everything else travels.

captions.fr: « Sans essieu, la roue n'est qu'un rouleau qui se croit quelqu'un. »
captions.en: Without an axle, a wheel is just a roller with ideas.

caption_style: small serif italic (Liberation Serif Italic) in the lower charcoal band; FR line above, EN subtitle below in a smaller size; white-scratched ghost of the type, no box

homage_line.fr: d'après Teuf-Teuf de Jean Jabely (1956) · légendes originales, pas le texte de Queneau
homage_line.en: after Jean Jabely's Teuf-Teuf (1956) · original captions, not Queneau's text
